checks: Fresh panel opens on the authoritative CADe circuit, with no disabled route buttons, automatic practice or expanded options. Drawing precedes tools.
Initial and expanded views fit seven viewport sizes with accessible close/expand controls and no horizontal overflow.
Selected line keeps all known cable branches visible; practice opens only on request and its settings remain optional.

Unplugged CONTROL switches cannot energize source; plug enables wired control. FUERZA moves all three poles, supports keyboard, and reports ON/OFF. Unplug drops holding relay and pilots without deleting cables or restarting on reconnect.
Both contactors show gray NC and blue NO with visible legends and user-supplied interpretation in inspector; source and coil colors remain separate.
Real mobile touch operates the plug and physical FUERZA/CONTROL switches on the source plate.
